verdict.rationale: BVNK documents its own background automation: a payment rule (POST /payment/v1/rules) links a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address so incoming funds are automatically on-ramped to crypto and sent on without manual action. This is a single, narrow rule type rather than a general automation facility. Webhooks only notify external systems and do not count as automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose or configurable automation beyond the fiat-to-crypto rule, scheduling or trigger-action workflows, agent-driven autonomous operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
